issue:
Invariance "MANAGER.__dict__ == manager.AstroidManager.brain" no longer holds
### Steps to reproduce
Up until commit bbcc58bd52e7f295b77a8618b19b2364625590a2 the following equality would be guaranteed:

```
assert MANAGER.always_load_extensions == manager.AstroidManager.brain['always_load_extensions']
```

This apparently causes https://github.com/pylint-dev/pylint/issues/7433
